body:
MSVC reports warning C5260 ("the constant variable … has internal linkage in an included header file context, but external linkage in imported header unit context") for `to_chars.hpp` when the library is used as a header unit or through a module, see #4826.

The warning comes from `kAlpha` and `kGamma`, the only `constexpr` variables at namespace scope in that file. The other constants there are function-local or static members. This declares the two constants `JSON_INLINE_VARIABLE constexpr`, which the library already uses for `static_const`. It expands to `inline` from C++17 on and to nothing before, so C++11 and C++14 are unchanged.

Not verified on MSVC locally. Checked with Apple Clang at C++11, C++17, and C++20 for both headers (`-Wall -Wextra -Werror`, dumping floating-point numbers).

## API impact

No breaking changes. The two constants are in `nlohmann::detail::dtoa_impl` and keep their values.
